slides.h1: Your Rasi Says Yes. Your Navamsa Says No. Now What?
slides.sub: A good reading resolves the contradiction. A weak one averages it into mush.

slides.h2: Why the two charts can disagree
slides.body: The Rasi (main birth chart) shows the visible promise. The Navamsa (the ninth divisional chart, D-9) shows inner strength and how a planet matures over time.
Many apps score both charts and blend the result into 'moderate'. That answer is useless. A strong promise with a weak foundation is a specific situation, not a mild one.

slides.h2: The rigorous fix: ask what each chart governs
slides.body: Rasi usually decides what appears in life. Navamsa decides how well it holds and whether it matures. Contradiction often means 'visible, but fragile'.

points: Is the planet strong in both charts, or only one?
Vargottama (same sign in both) adds consistency
What does the running dasha activate?

slides.body: Not 'maybe'. Something like: this theme shows early, but needs maintenance, and the dasha of the weaker planet is when it is tested.
Software can compute and compare every layer in seconds. The judgment about what the contradiction means still belongs to a trained astrologer.
